source.title: Job Hunting Is a Data Problem. I Treated It Like One.

title: Job Hunting Is a Data Pipeline
subtitle: Deterministic SQL beats GenAI guesswork, with one agentic switch
supportLine: Spec first. Typed tools do the work. Models step in only when judgment is needed.
visualConcept: Abstract rows of a data table on the right, glowing coral and amber, flowing downward and narrowing into a clean funnel/pipeline shape, small nodes turning into a single connected line at the bottom to suggest deterministic filtering and scoring; subtle grid and dotted schema lines in the background, one small node glowing brighter to suggest an agentic toggle switching on; no literal charts, no readable text inside the artwork, no logos.
style: modern editorial tech illustration, warm coral and amber gradient background, soft geometric shapes, subtle grain, clean sans-serif typography, high contrast for legibility at thumbnail size
